item.description: The first wave of a “very dangerous” atmospheric river storm dumped sometimes-torrential rain on the Southland Wednesday, with double-digit precipitation falling in some mountain areas and leading to freeway flooding and fears of debris flows in recent burn areas, where residents were under evacuation warnings or orders.
